102.title: feat: implement #5
102.body:
Closes #5. Implements C1 on `price(cart, now)`; the port is `src/pricing.py`.

## Contract deviations

- **C2** — added: an offer whose `expires_at` equals `now` is excluded (`expires_at <= now`) — the approved text was silent on the boundary.
